mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE rises >0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% year-over-year signals weakening household demand, which reduces earnings growth and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS YoY change < -2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO falls > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls above 100,000 coinciding with a rise in the unemployment rate signals a mixed labor market, which reduces earnings growth and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 100,000 AND UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when both conditions are met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the Housing Starts index exceeding 10% signals weakening housing demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST falls > 10% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below the 5th percentile of the past 5 years signals a severe weakening in household demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls below 5th percentile of last 5 years in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS falls below 5th percentile (t-test p > 0.05).
